narr: Training thunderstorms affected the far northeast Tennessee valley and southwest Virginia on the evening of the 30th, producing some flash flooding across those areas.
ev: Flooding reported on Weaver Pike near intersections at Bristol Heights Road and also Bellebrook Road. Reports of 8 to 10 inches of water over the road there, with flood waters going into Bristol Heights Estates mobile home park. Also flooding on nearby Ratheon Road noted.
Social media reports and pictures showed that several roads in and around Kingsport, including Lynn Garden, Sullivan Street, Stone Drive, Lomax Street, and Riverport Road, had water over them.
The Scannerfood Facebook page relayed pictures of Buncombe Road in Blountville being closed by high water over the roadway.
The Scannerfood Facebook page relayed a report of shed collapsing due to floodwaters.

The Scannerfood Facebook page shared reports of a small sinkhole opening up on Kitzmiller Road at the railroad pass due to flooding. It slowly expanded in size between 8:00 PM and 9:30 PM EDT before local government personnel closed that portion of the road.
